taste.name: One accent, reserved for the next action
taste.trigger: When a workout screen has dozens of tappable things and the user must find the one that advances the session
taste.decision: Chose a single violet (#9482FF) on the start button and the active tab over color-coding each muscle group or each control
taste.reason: Mid-set, the eye should land on 'what do I press now' without reading; a second saturated color would make it a search
evidence: 3 accent text uses vs 23 uses of #B2B7CC

taste.name: Edge-lit glass cards on blue-tinted blacks
taste.trigger: When stacking 18+ exercise cards on a near-black background where borders and flat fills disappear or look heavy
taste.decision: Chose a deep offset shadow plus a 1px inset white highlight on translucent cards over outlined or flat-fill cards
taste.reason: A lit top edge reads as a physical lip, so cards separate from each other and the background without adding border lines to scan past
evidence: 7 of 10 shadowed elements use 0 12px 32px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.65) + inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08); the other 3 vary only in blur and alpha
card fill rgba(24,26,40,.5) covers 70.1% of area
neutrals #090A11/#181A28/#23263A all tilt blue-violet, not pure gray

taste.name: Condensed caps for names, plain width for data
taste.trigger: When workout titles like 'A — Upper (peito, costas, ombro, braços + postural)' must fit a 576px column next to numeric inputs
taste.decision: Chose two widths of one family (Barlow Condensed for h1/h2, Barlow for the other 171 text nodes) over an unrelated display/body pairing
taste.reason: Condensed heads buy horizontal room and read as gym signage; staying in one family keeps numerals and labels matched in shape
evidence: h1 30px/800 Barlow Condensed vs body 14px/500 Barlow (2.14x)

taste.name: Phone column even on desktop (restraint)
taste.trigger: When the same page is opened on a 1440px desktop but is really used with one thumb between sets
taste.decision: Chose a fixed 576px single column with a 96px bottom reserve for a floating tab bar over a multi-column desktop dashboard
taste.reason: The user's context is the phone in the gym; widening the layout would add scanning distance without adding information needed mid-workout
evidence: 3-item bottom nav, one exercise card expanded at a time
